svg.aria-label: DHL GSC (onsite). Process Automation Intern. Jul 2026 - now. Working with the ELK Stack, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana for logging, monitoring and system observability. Supporting cloud-based monitoring and observability across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform. Contributing to automation and monitoring workflows with UiPath to improve system visibility and operational efficiency.
